entry.name: Brave
entry.driverSource: the Chrome for Testing chromedriver already here for Chrome 153 (Brave 1.95.104 is Chromium 153.0.8010.53, the same build)
entry.verified: codesign --verify --deep --strict ok (after xattr -cr: ditto carried a com.apple.FinderInfo attribute over from the dmg, which strict verification rejects as detritus), spctl accepted (Notarized Developer ID, Brave Software, Inc. KL8N8XSYF4)
entry.notes: Copied out of the dmg (hdiutil attach -nobrowse -readonly, detached). chromedriver reports its Chromium version; the harness records Brave's own (version) and the Chromium (chromium).
